doubts.claim_under_doubt: Requiring handbackOrigin === 'subagent' drops only progress notes, never a real final report
doubts.disproof_attempt: Marker-less agent-message envelopes (SendMessage-reporting agents, team-mode teammates, older CLI transcripts) get origin 'session' and no longer count as the agent's answer or enable Jump to message in chat.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: RESOLVED BY REBUTTAL: the filter is the explicit campaign requirement (V3 carried-over follow-up). Claude Code subagent completions always carry the [Subagent hand-back] marker; marker-less envelopes are progress or teammate messages, which is exactly what the filter must exclude. A fallback to the last session-origin card from the same sender is recorded as a follow-up, not shipped.

doubts.disproof_attempt: .glass-card and .flightplan are in the override list and are used on Ships Log and the Intent Wizard rail.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: DEFERRED as follow-up: the stronger ring on those on-photo surfaces is an accessibility improvement; narrowing or accepting is a product call.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Focus moves to Back on card-open
doubts.disproof_attempt: Portal content mounts a render later, so the effect finds no node; Back gets focus only via Radix FocusScope first-tabbable.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: DEFERRED: current behaviour is correct; add onOpenAutoFocus plus an assertion as hardening.

doubts.disproof_attempt: Unlayered opacity .7 beats focus-visible:opacity-100 for keyboard users on coarse-pointer devices.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: DEFERRED: add .vtb-close:focus-visible opacity 1 and fix the comment.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: 44px and motion guards cannot be fooled
doubts.disproof_attempt: touch44 regex unanchored; flat() skips @supports/@layer; MOTION ignores longhands.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: DEFERRED: anchor the regex, recurse into @supports/@layer, widen MOTION.
